title: Badge CTA Outline
description: Small outline CTA badge. CTA orange border and text on white, fills solid on hover.

styles.css: &{transition: background-color 200ms ease, border-color 200ms ease, color 180ms ease; display: inline-block;} &:hover{background-color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-500); color: var(--wp--preset--color--base); border-color: var(--wp--preset--color--cta-500);} & a{transition: color 200ms ease;} & a:hover{color: var(--wp--preset--color--base); text-decoration: none;} & a:active{color: var(--wp--preset--color--base); text-decoration: none;} & a:focus-visible{outline: 2px solid var(--wp--preset--color--focus-background); outline-offset: 2px;}
